clipsPosting.sub.en: Every finished clip, with where it has been posted.
clipsPosting.sub.zh: 全部成品切片，以及它们的发布去向。

clipsPosting.staffSub.en: Every producer's finished clips, with where each one has been posted.
clipsPosting.staffSub.zh: 各家制片公司的成品切片，以及每条的发布去向。

clipsPosting.noMatches.en: No finished clip matches these filters.
clipsPosting.noMatches.zh: 没有符合这些筛选条件的成品切片。

clipsPosting.noConnection.en: This producer has no Meta account yet.
clipsPosting.noConnection.zh: 这家制片公司还没有 Meta 账户。

clipsPosting.noInstagram.en: This Meta account carries no Instagram identity.
clipsPosting.noInstagram.zh: 这个 Meta 账户还没有绑定 Instagram 身份。

clipsPosting.cannotPost.en: Only an approver or a Studio administrator may post.
clipsPosting.cannotPost.zh: 只有审批人或 Studio 管理员可以发布。

clipsPosting.dialog.publicWarning.en: This publishes a public post on {name} now.
clipsPosting.dialog.publicWarning.zh: 这会立刻在 {name} 上发布一条公开帖子。

clipsPosting.dialog.again.en: This clip already has a published post on this account. Publishing again creates a second post.
clipsPosting.dialog.again.zh: 这条切片在该账户上已有发布成功的帖子。再次发布会新增一条帖子。

clipsPosting.placementsWarning.en: Assign a Facebook Page and the Instagram identity required by these placements.
clipsPosting.placementsWarning.zh: 请先分配这些版位所需的 Facebook 公共主页和 Instagram 身份。

clipsPosting.instagramNotInPlacements.en: This draft holds Instagram content while the placements exclude Instagram. Add Instagram to the placements, or remove that content.
clipsPosting.instagramNotInPlacements.zh: 草稿里有 Instagram 素材，但版位中没有 Instagram。请在版位中加入 Instagram，或移除该素材。

contentPicker.clipsEmpty.en: No finished clip for this producer yet. Clips are cut after an episode video is uploaded.
contentPicker.clipsEmpty.zh: 这家制片公司还没有成品切片。上传分集视频后会自动切片。

contentPicker.pageEmpty.en: No recent post on this account.
contentPicker.pageEmpty.zh: 这个账户最近没有帖子。

contentPicker.chooseAccount.en: Choose an ad account first; its Facebook Page and Instagram posts are read from that account.
contentPicker.chooseAccount.zh: 请先选择广告账户，再读取它的 Facebook 公共主页和 Instagram 帖子。

contentPicker.pasteHint.en: Paste a Facebook post id (pageID_postID) or an Instagram media id you already have.
contentPicker.pasteHint.zh: 粘贴已有的 Facebook 帖子 ID（pageID_postID）或 Instagram 媒体 ID。

contentPicker.instagramAdded.en: The Instagram post was added too, because Instagram is in the placements.
contentPicker.instagramAdded.zh: 版位中包含 Instagram，所以同时添加了 Instagram 帖子。
